title: Make subcommand --help print usage instead of an error
intent: `node src/cli.js gate check --help` (and every other subcommand) fails with "Unknown option '--help'". A reader who asks a command for help should get the usage text and exit 0. This is the representative low-risk task that finishes issue #7.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `--help` or `-h` after any command or subcommand (validate, schema, policy, evidence, gate, compact, settings) prints the usage text to stdout and exits 0
Unknown options other than --help/-h still fail with exit 1 as before
npm test, npm run validate:examples, node src/cli.js policy check and git diff --check all pass
